items.source: Returns the value of the given PersistentProperty of the underlying bean instance.
items.translation: 返回底层 Bean 实例中给定PersistentProperty的值。

items.source: This service supports mutation for immutable classes by creating new object instances. These are managed as state of PersistentPropertyAccessor and must be obtained from getBean() after processing all updates.
items.translation: 该服务通过创建新的对象实例来支持不可变类的变更操作。这些实例作为PersistentPropertyAccessor的状态进行管理，必须在处理完所有更新后从getBean()中获取。

items.source: Sets the given PersistentProperty to the given value. Will do type conversion if a ConversionService is configured.
items.translation: 将给定的 PersistentProperty 设置为给定值。如果配置了 ConversionService，则执行类型转换。

items.source: Sets the given PersistentProperty to the given value.
items.translation: 将给定的PersistentProperty设置为给定值。

items.source: Returns the underlying bean. The actual instance may change between setProperty(PersistentProperty, Object) calls.
items.translation: 返回底层 Bean。实际实例可能在以下调用之间发生变化： setProperty(PersistentProperty, Object)

items.source: MappingException - in case an exception occurred when setting the property value.
items.translation: MappingException - 在设置属性值时发生异常的情况下。

items.source: Oliver Gierke, Mark Paluch, Johannes Englmeier

Domain service to allow accessing and setting PersistentPropertys of an entity. Usually obtained through PersistentEntity.getPropertyAccessor(Object). In case type conversion shall be applied on property access, use a ConvertingPropertyAccessor.
items.translation: 领域服务，用于访问和设置实体的PersistentProperty。通常通过PersistentEntity.getPropertyAccessor(Object)获取。如果在属性访问时需要应用类型转换，请使用ConvertingPropertyAccessor。
